summary: Tested Make.com webhook notification feature (Super Admin only) end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS covering GET/PUT/POST/DELIVERIES endpoints, HTTPS validation, auth enforcement, persistence, 404 for unknown tenants, and test webhook route. Frontend (Playwright): Super Admin login -> /super-admin -> Medina tenant Bell button opens Notification Settings dialog with both tabs (Webhook Settings + Delivery History), URL/API key/switch/save/test all wired to backend, save shows success toast 'Webhook settings saved successfully', Test Webhook correctly shows failure toast 'Webhook test failed: HTTP 404: Not found' for the placeholder Make.com URL (expected - endpoint is functioning; failure is delivery-side), Delivery History tab renders empty state 'No webhook deliveries yet' with Refresh button. All acceptance criteria from the review are met.

backend_pytest_9_of_9_pass.test_update_and_persist_webhook_settings: PASS - PUT persists webhook_url/enabled/api_key; GET confirms; has_api_key=true (key not exposed)
backend_pytest_9_of_9_pass.test_get_deliveries: PASS - returns deliveries list scoped by tenant

frontend_playwright.test_webhook_button_wired_to_backend: PASS - shows delivery failure toast (expected: placeholder URL 404). Endpoint responded 400 with meaningful error.
frontend_playwright.delivery_history_tab_empty_state: PASS - 'No webhook deliveries yet' + Refresh button

action_items: LOW: Review request stated the button testid is 'webhook-settings-btn-medina-county', but the actual subdomain is 'medina' so the rendered testid is 'webhook-settings-btn-medina'. Either update the subdomain to 'medina-county' in the tenant seed OR update review docs. Not a bug, just a discrepancy with the request text.

LOW: Test webhook deliveries are NOT recorded in webhook_deliveries collection (only send_webhook records them; test_webhook uses its own httpx.post). Consider recording test attempts too so users can debug test failures via Delivery History.
LOW: Add data-testid to the Delivery History Refresh button and to individual delivery rows for future automation.
LOW: DialogTitle uses '{selectedTenant?.name}' but does not have a data-testid; consider 'webhook-dialog-title' for deterministic tests.
critical_code_review_comments: webhook_service.test_webhook duplicates the httpx call logic from send_webhook (headers, payload envelope, error handling). Extract a shared _post_to_make() helper to eliminate ~40 lines of duplication.

PUT /webhook-settings validates URL starts with 'https://' but does NOT further validate it's a Make.com URL or a well-formed URL (e.g. 'https://x' would pass). Consider urllib.parse validation and optional host allowlist ['hook.us1.make.com','hook.eu1.make.com', etc.] to prevent SSRF against internal networks.

WebhookSettingsResponse.has_api_key correctly hides the actual key, good. However the API key is stored plaintext in tenants.settings.webhook_api_key - consider encrypting at rest or storing in a secrets store.
webhook_deliveries collection has no TTL index or size cap. Over time this collection will grow unbounded per tenant. Add a TTL index (e.g. 30-90 days) or a background cleanup.

send_webhook records the FULL event payload including personnel PII (email/phone) into webhook_deliveries. Combined with no TTL, this is a data-retention concern - either scrub PII from stored payloads or add retention policy.

Retry loop in send_webhook only retries on httpx errors, not on 5xx from Make.com (raise_for_status raises HTTPStatusError which is not caught by the except clause listing HTTPError - actually HTTPStatusError IS a subclass of HTTPError, so it is caught, but the check should be verified). Also no jitter in backoff (2**attempt) - fine for 3 attempts but note.

SuperAdminDashboard.js is now ~1075 lines - approaching the 700-line refactor threshold. The webhook dialog (~230 lines) is a clear candidate to extract into its own component (WebhookSettingsDialog.jsx).
